steps.label: 1. SYN

steps.label: 2. SYN-ACK

steps.label: 3. ACK

code:
TCP                         UDP
Connection-oriented         Connectionless
Handshake required          No handshake
Ordered, reliable           Fire-and-forget
Retransmits lost data       Drops and moves on
More overhead                Lower latency
caption: TCP guarantees delivery; UDP trades that guarantee for speed.

steps.label: TCP
steps.sub: HTTP/HTTPS, SMTP email, FTP — a dropped byte breaks the result

steps.label: UDP
steps.sub: DNS queries, streaming video, VoIP — speed beats perfect delivery
